test_title: PYST 65: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). B sits to the immediate left of E. C sits to the immediate left of F. F sits second to the left of G. D sits third to the left of E.

Who sits third to the left of A?
solution:
Given:

 A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

B sits to the immediate left of E.

D sits third to the left of E.

C sits to the immediate left of F.

F sits second to the left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/710fc6b163caf30e2fc6e7921f5339a29dc9fb78b4fb14c5a3934089685f71d4.png] 

Thus, G sits third to the left of A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
